name: MCP Atlassian
description: A Model Context Protocol server for Atlassian Jira and Confluence that supports both Cloud and On-Prem/Data Center deployments. It enables AI assistants to search, create, and manage issues and pages using secure authentication methods like PAT and OAuth.

rawRecord.description: A Model Context Protocol server for Atlassian Jira and Confluence that supports both Cloud and On-Prem/Data Center deployments. It enables AI assistants to search, create, and manage issues and pages using secure authentication methods like PAT and OAuth.

JIRA_URL.description: The URL of your Jira instance (e.g., https://your-company.atlassian.net).

JIRA_USERNAME.description: Your Jira username or email address (required for Cloud).

CONFLUENCE_URL.description: The URL of your Confluence instance (e.g., https://your-company.atlassian.net/wiki).

JIRA_API_TOKEN.description: Your Jira API token (required for Cloud).

JIRA_CLIENT_KEY.description: Path to the client key for Jira authentication.

JIRA_SSL_VERIFY.description: Set to 'false' to disable SSL certificate verification for Jira.

JIRA_CLIENT_CERT.description: Path to the client certificate for Jira authentication.

CONFLUENCE_USERNAME.description: Your Confluence username or email address (required for Cloud).

JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN.description: Personal Access Token for Jira Server/Data Center (replaces username/API token).

CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN.description: Your Confluence API token (required for Cloud).

CONFLUENCE_CLIENT_KEY.description: Path to the client key for Confluence authentication.

CONFLUENCE_SSL_VERIFY.description: Set to 'false' to disable SSL certificate verification for Confluence.

CONFLUENCE_CLIENT_CERT.description: Path to the client certificate for Confluence authentication.

CONFLUENCE_PERSONAL_TOKEN.description: Personal Access Token for Confluence Server/Data Center (replaces username/API token).
